environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EKS cluster behind an internal-scheme AWS Application Load Balancer (scheme: internal). The ALB resides in private subnets (10.0.64.0/19, 10.0.96.0/19) with no Internet Gateway route. Security group sg-0a4f2e8c9b allows inbound TCP/443 only from source prefixes matching the corporate VPN egress range (172.16.0.0/12) and the shared-services VPC CIDR (10.1.0.0/16) via a VPC peering connection (pcx-0f3a7b2d). Additionally, a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy of type Ingress is applied to the namespace restricting pod-to-pod traffic to only the API gateway pods labeled app=api-gw in namespace platform. AWS PrivateLink is NOT used; connectivity relies on the peering + SG combination. The ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with a lifecycle policy but no real-time alerting is configured on them.

config.route_table: no igw route, only local + pcx-0f3a7b2d + nat-gw for egress
